title: MeshTeacher Route B — pre-evaluation freeze commitments (SHA-256)
description:
Time-stamped cryptographic commitments made before evaluating sealed test sets of the MeshTeacher Route B study (learned anisotropic metrics for closed-loop finite-element mesh adaptation, manufactured T2-M benchmark).

G2 (release v1.0-g2): SHA-256(G2_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json) = 77fc5f52f95a94c41f27efbb5b55eb78f654ddf384b18143cc9cbaa74f6dea1b — frozen student network, code, protocol and addenda, sealed test (24) and OOD (12) designs.

G3 (release v1.1-g3): SHA-256(G3_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json) = 92951e830361bb40ad9733eedbe5b6c11d803a0e174b8c070f061f8c0cf17bf7 — hybrid policy (Addendum H, k = 2), its code and analysis, new sealed test2 (24) and ood2 (12) designs.

G4 (release v1.2-g4): SHA-256(G4_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json) = 762c00033a8acc0b7e90b1a955b598e2cc019e1e7cd829e7714eba8e5126582e — source/residual ablation (Addendum G4): S-f student, masking and analysis code, new sealed test3 (24) and ood3 (12) designs.

None of the corresponding instances had been solved when each commitment was made. The manifests and all listed files will be released with the article.
